contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime residential East Asian city lane with tiled shopfronts, a convenience store, potted plants, utility poles and overhead wires; dry asphalt, no rain depicted; humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The pale gray hoodie (separate product) is worn under the washed denim jacket; its body and hood back are partly hidden and conservatively reconstructed. Gray ribbed socks are visible above both ivory sneakers. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All 27 isolated products have complete silhouettes, matching garment colors and visible details, clean alpha edges across four backgrounds, matching footwear/sock pairs, gold hoop pair and complete watch. No props or forced running trim. Look05 jeans retain visible rear construction; hidden garment fronts are conservative reconstructions. No visible matte, checkerboard or external shadow.

deck.ko: 데님과 회색 후드가 만드는 겹친 목선.
deck.en: Denim and gray form two clear neckline layers.
deck.de: Jeans und Grau bilden zwei klare Lagen am Hals.

intro.ko: 발을 잠시 올리고 엉킨 끈을 정리하는 장면입니다.
intro.en: One foot is raised briefly while a drawstring is put back in order.
intro.de: Ein Fuß wird kurz angehoben, während die Kordel geordnet wird.

body.ko: 짧은 인디고 재킷에서 회색 후드와 긴 끈을 꺼냈습니다. 검정 크롭트 팬츠는 발목을 드러내고 회색 양말이 후디 색을 아래에서 반복합니다. 아이보리 캔버스화는 밝지만 과하게 튀지 않는 끝점입니다. 낮의 플래시는 데님 봉제선과 후드의 부드러운 주름을 구분합니다.
body.en: The gray hood and long cords sit outside the short indigo jacket. Cropped black trousers reveal gray socks that repeat the hoodie color below. Ivory canvas shoes provide a pale, quiet finish. Daylight flash separates denim seams from the softer hood folds.
body.de: Graue Kapuze und lange Kordeln liegen über der kurzen indigoblauen Jacke. Die verkürzte schwarze Hose zeigt graue Socken, die den Hoodie-Farbton wiederholen. Elfenbeinfarbene Canvas-Schuhe bilden einen ruhigen hellen Abschluss. Tageslichtblitz trennt Jeansnähte von weichen Kapuzenfalten.

pull.en: A gray line connects the layers.
pull.de: Eine graue Linie verbindet die Lagen.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A gray line connects the layers.

tip.ko: 양말 높이는 양쪽을 맞추고 후디 끈은 재킷 밖에 평평하게 두세요.
tip.en: Match sock heights and lay the hoodie cords flat outside the jacket.
tip.de: Socken gleich hoch tragen und die Kordeln flach außerhalb der Jacke legen.

description.ko: 연한 인디고 워싱에 칼라, 단추, 덮개 가슴 주머니가 있는 재킷.
description.en: Faded indigo jacket with a collar, buttons and flap chest pockets.
description.de: Verblasste indigoblaue Jacke mit Kragen, Knöpfen und Brustklappentaschen.

howToWear.ko: 회색 후드를 칼라 밖에 꺼내 두 겹의 목선을 구분하세요.
howToWear.en: Pull the gray hood outside the collar to separate the neck layers.
howToWear.de: Die graue Kapuze über den Kragen legen und beide Lagen trennen.
